commits.summary: Start the setup record of the merged Java PR links L01–L20 brief
commits.body: The setup agent of the L01–L20 brief fetched both pinned revisions of all 20 merged pull requests into the shared bare mirrors (40 of 40, by SHA at depth 1) and made one worktree per revision under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20. Checked with gh api and the commit objects: every PR is merged with the brief's after pin as its merge commit, the after pin's first parent is the brief's before pin in 19 cases, and picocli's after pin reaches the before pin through the three rebased commits the brief describes. Each landed diff names exactly the PR's changed files. The record lists every revision with its tree and parents; builds and test runs follow.
